tasks.gr10-networks-data-handling-t3: Grade 10 IT Term 3: Network types, protocols, internet services, and file/data handling in programs.
tasks.gr10-integrated-solution-development-t3: Grade 10 IT Term 3: Developing integrated solutions combining data, logic, and user interface components.
tasks.gr10-computer-management-t3: Topic: Computer Management: Files, Housekeeping and Security. Cover file types and extensions, saving as another type, housekeeping (disk clean-up, updates, backup, compression, file naming), security features (firewall, anti-virus, spyware and adware controls), installing and uninstalling software, and licence keys. Ask Grade 10 learners to match a file type, choose a housekeeping task, or say what a security feature does.
tasks.gr10-internet-www-t3: Topic: The Internet and the World Wide Web. Cover the Internet, IP addresses, domain names and DNS, ISPs and connections, the Web, URLs, web pages and websites, browsers, search engines and search techniques. Ask Grade 10 learners to define a term, pick out the parts of a URL, or choose a search technique.
tasks.gr10-email-internet-threats-popia-t3: Topic: E-mail and Internet Threats, Safe Use and POPIA. Cover viruses, hoaxes, fake news, spam, phishing, e-mail spoofing and pharming (described only, never instructions), safe e-mail and Internet habits, and the purpose of POPIA. Ask Grade 10 learners to recognise a threat, choose a safe habit, or say what POPIA protects.
tasks.gr10-loops-strings-algorithms-t3: Topic: Loops, Strings, Prime Numbers and GCD. Cover for, while and repeat-until loops, handling a string character by character, the Delphi string methods Length, Pos, Copy, Delete, Insert, Trim and UpperCase, prime number tests, GCD and LCM. Ask Grade 10 learners to trace a loop, predict the result of a string method, or test a number for prime.
tasks.gr10-gui-design-timer-project-t3: Topic: GUI Design, the Timer and Planning a Project. Cover human-computer interaction and grouping of components, panels and tabbed panes, a timer component for simple animation, program persistence, and planning a project from user stories to test cases. Ask Grade 10 learners to judge an interface, work out a timer result, or write a test case.
